Subject: Ironvale Warehousing - Quote in Progress

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the Ironvale Warehousing submission! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs for the three locations with $19.9M total insured value.

Everything looks good, and this risk fits well within our appetite. I'm working on putting together a competitive quote for the January 3, 2027 effective date and should have something to you shortly.

I'll reach out if any questions come up as I'm reviewing the details, but at this point we have what we need to move forward.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
